meta.name: Turu Love
meta.description: How far will you go to prove your 'turu' love? Watch the twisted love story of three crazy individuals tangled with craziness.

videos.title: Biyer Paka Kotha
videos.overview: Aritra travels to Kolkata from Durgapur, to meet his bride-to-be Tiyasha but she discovers something about him that rocks the boat.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While Aritra is struggling in Kolkata, a social media post by Tiyasha shakes his world.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Vrinda helps Aritra find a unique job. She is moved by Aritra's faith and struggle towards the idea of true love.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Vrinda and Aritra fight over Tiyasha when she discovers that Aritra can go to any extent to fulfill a promise to Tiyasha.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Aritra is one step closer to fulfilling his promise. But something's stopping him from taking a decision.
